links.outcome: Student disclosure of patient-identifying information to generative AI tools during clinical placements
links.effect: Among 204 users, 48 (23.5%) reported at least 1 disclosure of patient-identifying information, and 96 (47.1%) reported processing real medical content perceived as anonymized.
links.quote: Although most users reported never entering direct patient identifiers, 48 (23.5%) reported at least 1 disclosure of patient-identifying information, and 96 (47.1%) reported processing real medical content perceived as anonymized.

links.outcome: Unsanctioned generative AI use by students during clinical placements
links.effect: 204 (52.6%) of 388 students reported using GenAI during clinical placements; 23.5% of users reported disclosing patient-identifying information.
links.quote: Overall, 204 (52.6%) students reported using GenAI during clinical placements.

unlisted_practices: Structured GenAI curricula for health professional students
Best-practice clinical guide for student GenAI use

screen.reason: The study is an empirical survey investigating real-world use, practices, risks, and governance needs regarding generative AI by health professional students during actual clinical placements.
